{{Quote|In order to deserve the Mark of the Hero, you must undergo four different tasks and gain the Marks of Courage, Honor, Intellect, and Altrusim.|A [[Unidentified Rodian hermit|Rodian hermit]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
The '''Mark of the Hero''' was a ring of great power gifted to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who had gone above and beyond in his protection of the inhabitants of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|You have done great things in the name of the light. I am honored to be in your presence. Take my Mark of The Hero and let it remind you of your cause. Do not forget why you fight. Good luck, young warrior.|A Rodian hermit, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
The ring was originally in the possession of a [[Unidentified Rodian hermit|Rodian hermit]] who lived in a [[Squill Cave|squill cave]] on Tatooine after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> a spacer who was exploring the cave met the hermit at his home at the bottom of the cave. After a brief discussion between the two, the spacer made it clear they did not support the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The hermit asked the spacer if they would retrieve a missing item of his from mouth of the cave, which the spacer agreed to do. The item turned out to be a [[Squill (creature)|squill]] skull. After returning it to the mysterious hermit, he tasked the spacer with four more heroic acts on Tatooine, which the spacer readily accepted.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

The spacer soundly completed the four [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|tasks]], displaying intelligence to deduce who was a troubled [[Tearfin|bounty hunter's]] target, honor by refusing to be corrupted by [[Sand slum pirates|pirates]], courage by killing a ferocious [[Bladeback boar/Legends|bladeback boar]], and altruism by assisting a moisture farmer in distress by rescuing his family from the [[Sennex]] slavers. After all tasks were completed, the adventurer returned to the hermit and told him of their success. The hermit applauded the spacer for their bravery and heroism and declared them the [[Hero of Tatooine]]. He awarded them with four "trophies" &mdash; the [[Mark of Intellect]], the [[Mark of Honor]], the [[Mark of Courage]], and the [[Mark of Altruism]] &mdash; that formed a unique spherical sculpture, and the Mark of the Hero, which was believed to be able to bring its bearer back from the brink of death.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mark of the Hero appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mark of Honor was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG" /> released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]" on [[June 29]], [[2004]].<ref>{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref>

The Mark of the Hero was a unique ring awarded to players who completed the "Hero of Tatooine" questline. Its function in-game was that of resuscitation. If used within a certain time after dying, it would bring the user back to life. Its uses were limited to 50 however, after which it became mere jewelry. It could only be used once every twenty-three hours.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

The "Hero of Tatooine" questline was extensively revamped upon the introduction of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> but the quest rewards, such as the "Mark of Honor," were not altered.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />
